findings: Room index and panoramic context establish spatial browsing; two-up furniture cards become one-up on mobile.
Diagram and numeric facts distinguish assembled dimensions from variant package dimensions; the schematic is labelled not to scale.
Mobile review/pay has a complete two-item quote before payment in both DOM order and visual position.
Identity uses current admin/light brand ink and Geist, with a labelled explicit Continue state and optional verification disclosure.
Order rows have no mutation controls; profile sign-in email is displayed as read-only text.
Address validation is adjacent to the pincode field; default state and retained edits are clear.
Saved Craft product research capture has absent product photography; the comparison supports text/placement observation, not intended photo presentation.
limitations: Representative exports were inspected, not every pixel of all45 screens.
Text enlargement uses computed font sizes doubled; this does not certify browser zoom or assistive technology.
Hindi fixture shows a local script fallback and reflow, not a fully localized storefront or language usability study.
Prototype controls remain proposed; no actual commerce/identity/payment/account transaction was verified.
